description: Free, rate-limited demo of extract_json: up to 1000 characters of text and 5 fields (or a small schema). Use this to try the service; use extract_json for real work. Free, rate limited.

examples.text: Hi team, I'm Dana Ortiz, VP of Ops at Lumen Freight. Can we move Thursday's demo to Friday Nov 27 at 2pm ET? Reach me at dana@lumenfreight.com or (617) 555-0142.

fields.description: Shortcut instead of a schema: field names, optionally typed as name:type where type is string, number, integer, boolean, date, string[], number[] or object[] (e.g. ["name", "email", "total:number", "skills:string[]"]).

instructions.description: Optional extra guidance, e.g. 'dates as YYYY-MM-DD', 'amounts in USD'.

schema.description: A JSON Schema (type: object, with properties) describing the JSON you want back. Supports type, properties, required, items, enum, description. Provide this OR fields.

text.description: The unstructured text to extract from (max 1000 characters).

name: extract_json_lite

data.description: The extracted JSON. Validates against your schema; values not found in the text are null.

missing.description: Paths of requested fields that were not found in the text (returned as null).

title: Extract JSON (free demo)
